answer: Operator-liability escrow: each agent wallet maps to a persistent operator identity via hardware attestation, and every action draws from a shared operator quota. When N wallets from one operator trip a sybil detector, the protocol freezes the operator's nectar reward stream and places a timber lien on all registered resources, while routing affected traffic through a degraded oasis queue until resolution. Honest operators recoup the lien; attackers forfeit it entirely, making mass-identity farming cost the whole operation.
